text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Premium photorealistic wardrobe catalog asset. Portrait 2:3, pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio illumination, realistic fabric and metal texture, subtle contact shadows, whole object uncropped with generous margin. No captions, price labels, watermarks, surroundings or people. Garments: Olive-taupe wool oversized double-breasted suit with wide notch lapels, matching five-button vest and long wide pleated suit trousers, white cotton shirt, brown leather dress shoes. Show one front-facing assembled outfit using hollow invisible-mannequin display, natural volume but absolutely no body, skin, head, hands, legs, visible mannequin or stand. Exclude ALL detachable accessories: bags, hats, eyeglasses, belts, watches, jewelry and handheld props. Integral garment trims remain. Show hollow inner neck and cuffs.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Remove ONLY the striped necktie completely. Leave the white shirt with its top button open. Preserve the olive-taupe suit jacket, vest, trousers, brown shoes, all tailoring, lighting, pure white background and empty invisible mannequin display exactly unchanged. No body or mannequin.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
